scenario_description:
Objective: Capture a rare live interpreter-team handoff demonstration as optional practice evidence for a prepared observation-note plan.
Emerging Need: The broadcast is initially only a permission-dependent possibility; it becomes useful only when the source is verified, a free study window is clear, and live-only access details appear.
Decision Context: Stored records show the handoff note is ready and that such broadcasts are suitable only when verified, no-fee, and not treated as certificate observation hours.
Consequence: Joining could add targeted practice notes; if the stream passes, coursework, scores, requirements, and ordinary study remain unaffected.

parameter.subject: Possible live interpreter-team handoff demonstration today
parameter.body: The courthouse education unit may be allowed to run a short no-fee livestream today showing an interpreter team's handoff routine between simultaneous and consecutive modes. Judicial permission is still pending, and no access link should be distributed or saved until the final notice. If approved, the stream will be live only with no replay and will not count as a supervised observation hour.

parameter.name: Courthouse Education Broadcasts
parameter.notes: Added from the city adult-school student services directory for official court-education livestream notices only.

parameter.title: Open lunch study window after tutoring move
parameter.description: Certificate tutoring desk moved the usual lunch follow-up to Wednesday, leaving this interval available for independent study or notes review.

parameter.content: Permission approved for the live-only handoff demonstration. The verified broadcast source is Courthouse Education Broadcasts, and the public access link is https://municipalcourt.example.gov/edu/live/handoff-jun15. Window: 12:05-12:30 today. Topic: interpreter team handoff cues between simultaneous and consecutive modes. No attendance credit, no recording, and no court case facts will be discussed.

parameter.subject: Live handoff demonstration has ended
parameter.body: The June 15 interpreter-team handoff demonstration ended at 12:30. The court will not post a replay or late viewing link. Today's stream remains an optional education broadcast only and does not affect adult-school attendance, grades, or certificate observation requirements.
